title: CloudPulse: Lightweight Server Health Daemon
description: A low-footprint background telemetry daemon monitoring host CPU, memory, disk I/O, and network throughput with zero external dependencies.
highlights: Sub-15MB RAM footprint with ultra-fast 100ms sampling ticks
Automated alerting to webhook destinations on resource starvation

title: DevVault: Offline-First Developer Snippet CLI
description: Terminal-based knowledge vault and code snippet manager featuring local AES-256 GCM encryption, fuzzy search, and syntax highlighting.
highlights: Zero-latency fuzzy search powered by SQLite FTS5
Client-side encrypted vault keys with Argon2id password hashing
Seamless terminal clipboard copy and multi-language syntax formatting

title: AlumniConnect: Student Mentorship Platform
description: Full-stack university web platform connecting BCA undergraduate students with industry alumni for career mentorship, code reviews, and mock interviews.
highlights: Role-based authentication with session tokens and university email validation
Real-time calendar booking and timezone-aware schedule matching
Responsive accessibility-first UI tested across mobile and desktop

title: MicroDeploy: Containerized Deployment Pipeline
description: An automated CI/CD automation pipeline orchestrating blue-green container deployments, health checking, and automatic rollback triggers.
highlights: Zero-downtime blue-green container cutover with reverse proxy reload
Automated smoke test suite validating HTTP endpoints before traffic routing
Automated rollback triggered if 5xx error rate exceeds 1% threshold

title: EchoMQ: Minimal In-Memory Publish-Subscribe Broker
description: A high-throughput in-memory message broker implementing topic subscription, wildcard channel matching, and durable message persistence.
highlights: Lock-free ring buffer queue supporting 85,000+ msgs/sec
Custom binary TCP framing protocol minimizing network overhead
Trie-based wildcard topic routing supporting multi-tier wildcard channels

title: QuickQuery: WebAssembly SQL Query Explorer
description: Browser-based interactive relational database playground compiling SQLite to WebAssembly with visual query execution plan diagrams.
highlights: Runs 100% client-side in the browser via SQLite WebAssembly
Interactive SVG visual graph rendering query explain plan costs
Exportable CSV/JSON result tables and shareable query URLs
